criteria.demonstration: Parsed copied grammar descriptors and typed argument factories separate syntax, category and lifetime enforcement. Complete preparation precedes bounded sink admission, so rejected appends preserve every byte and used; copied streaming messages instead retain exact accepted progress, which cannot be rolled back externally.

criteria.demonstration: Required parsed DSL and partial writer support implements copied32-byte formats/128-byte messages, repeated typed placeholders, exact prefix offsets, zero-progress backpressure, errors after acceptance, cancellation and protocol-uncertainty terminal states. Four actual local nonblocking-pipe executions observe EAGAIN then offsets0/2/4/5 and no post-cancel output; callbacks remain synchronous and externally serialized. limits: Parsed-program integrity and live disjoint objects are caller premises; C public fields are forgeable.
Writer callback is synchronous, nonretaining and nonreentrant; concurrent cancellation is not admitted.
Protocol-invalid reports make external accepted progress uncertain; no rollback guarantee.
POSIX pipe and C++ experiments are separate hosted comparisons, not ISO C or physical guarantees.
Finite author evidence is not independent human review or learner mastery; exact published C17/C23 unavailable.
